target: theta, conditional probability of a reported contact within seven days for a volunteer from a comparable fictional regime
sampling: Twelve binary records treated as conditionally independent Bernoulli(theta); Y is their sum, Binomial(12,theta)
predictive: beta-binomial for another 12 exchangeable records under the same model
missing: none in this fully specified fictional case
decision_threshold: 0.5 is an illustrative probability-scale reference, not a validated action threshold
computation: exact conjugate update and beta functions; no MCMC
